<div class="card-body">
'''Dr. Evazan''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Alien]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ドクター・エヴァザン</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">同じ位置にいる、武器が命中したか、「切断された腕」をつけられたキャラクターを、即座に“手術”する。が、腕が悪いので患者は、即座にロストする。彼の操縦する宇宙船は、戦闘力＋２。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-172o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">密輸屋。顔に醜いブラスター痕のある心の歪んだ“医師”。１２以上の星系で死刑判決。ポンダ・バーバの悪名高きパートナー。別名、ドクター・コーネリアス・ルーフー。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Dr. Evazan.

'''Card text:''' Immediately “operates” on a character at the same site that was just hit by a weapon or that has Disarmed. The patient is immediately lost. A starship he pilots is power +2.

'''Lore:''' Smuggler. A twisted “doctor” with an ugly blaster scar. Death sentence in 12 or more systems. Notorious partner of Ponda Baba. Alias Dr. Cornelius Rooboo.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese names 切断された腕 for Disarmed.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Dr. Evazan]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 98. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
